relocation_line: I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Boral team,

I'm Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'm looking for a laboratory technician job testing construction materials. The sampling and testing of concrete and other materials in your Winston Hills lab is the kind of work I want to get into.

In the diploma I studied soil testing standards (AS 1289). Before that, on site in the Philippines, I did inspections and quality checks and kept the material and progress records.

I'd move to Sydney and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa) and a full Victorian driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
